benchmark-version.alpacaeval.cd543a1

Prepared 10 Nov 2026 · Evidence snapshot 10 Nov 2026 · Report research-2026-11-10.prelaunch.1

Evidence & scope

Creator-maintained family/release documentation received separate AI source-content review of construction, label origin, format, evaluation conditions and stated access/license limitations. This is documentation review, not download or independent recount of corpus rows. The pinned release and parent family remain distinct; rights conflicts and version-specific unknowns are preserved in approved assertions.

Approved evidence · As of 10 Nov 2026

AlpacaEval creator documentation at cd543a1 · documents: The creators caution that the instruction set may miss advanced usage, automatic evaluators can favor style over factuality, and AlpacaEval does not measure model harms.

cohort2.dataset.claim.alpacaeval.limitations

  • These stated scope limitations prevent interpreting the benchmark as a model-release safety assessment.
  • This assertion originated as an author proposal; separate review receipts determine its current status.
